description: Choose, review, or change the `name` of a dismech Disease entry. Use when creating an entry (including from a stub, whose `label` is the MONDO label), renaming one, or reviewing a PR that adds or renames one. Covers the scope rule (the name must not be broader than the entry), when a single-gene entry takes a gene-related (dyadic) name, where an established name can be found, umbrella names that must not be used for a single entry, casing, and when to report a MONDO label upstream. Not for choosing the `disease_term` binding itself; see dismech-terms and mapping-analysis.
